name: Exterior Soffit RP Condition Assessment
intent: Visual inspection, adhesion test, mildew/algae assessment (priority check — soffit is #1 for mildew), moisture probe on wood, caulk condition assessment, vent condition check.
doctrine: RP assessment. All FIXED time, no modifiers. Mildew/algae is priority check for soffit (#1 degradation mechanism for sheltered overhead surface). Moisture probe on wood only — MC > 15% = stop work gate. Caulk assessment per Think Like a Water Drop. Vent condition check for paint clogging (vented soffit only).
